taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-14 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 161.1 | 3.39 | 3.39
2 | 1022.2 | 1.76 | 5.15
3 | 85.2 | 1.93 | 7.08
4 | 88.8 | 9.77 | 16.85
5 | 117.4 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-14
Curve type: KHA-type (5-layer curve)
Aquifer depth: 7.08 m – 16.85 m (Layer 4, 88.8 Ω·m, 9.77 m thick)
Recommendation: Target the moderate-resistivity saturated zone between ~7 m and ~17 m depth for screen placement; drill to at least 18–20 m to confirm the top of the underlying Layer 5 and verify aquifer thickness before finalizing casing design.
